replies.author: AtditC
replies.body:
1. Create New World
2. More World Options...
3. Change the world type to "Superflat"
4. Customize
5. Presets
6. Delete the code (usually 2;7,2x3,2;1;village)
7. Use the new code 2;0;1;
8. Use preset
9. Done
10. Done
11. Change the "Game Mode" to "Creative" and then CREATE A NEW WORLD!
12. Don't forget to fly, or you will fall into the void!
13. /setblock <x> <y> <z> stone
